turns.doctor_question: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Well, Dr. [Name]... I'm here because of my eating. I've been having these nights where I just eat and eat. And then... I just sit there. With all the crumbs and the empty containers around me. And I feel so ashamed. Just disgusted with myself, honestly. It gets so bad that the next morning, I can hardly bring myself to pray. I can't even look folks at church in the eye. I just can't keep living like this.

symptom_reasoning.S055: The patient explicitly reports feeling deeply ashamed and disgusted with themselves after episodes of excessive eating at night.

turns.doctor_question: After one of these episodes of eating a large amount, do you ever try to get rid of the food or make up for it—like by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot?
turns.patient_response: No, I don't do anything like that. I've never tried to make myself throw up, and I don't take laxatives or anything. And, well, at my age I'm certainly not out there exercising to burn it off. I just... I just sit there with a full stomach. I usually just go to bed feeling heavy and sick about what I just did.

symptom_reasoning.S047: The patient explicitly denies non-purging compensatory behaviors, noting they do not exercise to burn off the food.
symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly denies purging behaviors, stating they have never induced vomiting or taken laxatives after eating.
symptom_reasoning.S055: The patient describes going to bed feeling 'sick about what I just did,' indicating negative affect and guilt or distress following an eating episode.

turns.doctor_question: Over the past three months, about how often would you say these overeating episodes have been happening—roughly how many times per week?
turns.patient_response: Well, ever since my friend passed... I'd say these late-night eating spells have been happening at least once or twice most weeks. And there really hasn't been a month where they let up at all. It's just been going on like that steadily.
